extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Functions of body parts — legs walk/run/jump, hands hold/lift/button/wave, eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin feels touch. (2) Each sense organ has a special job — eyes=see, ears=hear, nose=smell, tongue=taste, skin=touch. (3) Care and hygiene — wash hands before eating, brush teeth every morning, wash eyes with clean water (never soap), keep sharp objects away from ears, avoid loud sounds, cover nose with handkerchief in dust. Misconceptions: 'eyes can hear' (eyes see, ears hear — each organ has its own job), 'hands are for walking' (legs walk, hands hold), 'we can wash eyes with soap' (never wash eyes with soap, use clean water). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function BodyFunctionsGame), NOT export default. Export interface BodyFunctionsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
